content: Modern invoice-extraction products increasingly market 'template-less' AI (vendor-agnostic, learns generally) as differentiated from older template-per-vendor systems. Even template-less products still improve accuracy from corrections over a review window. For a hackathon demo, an EXPLICIT named lab/source profile (saved mapping keyed to a column-signature) is more legible and demoable on video than an implicit statistical improvement, which is invisible in a single before/after comparison.
